scope: Deterministic verification only; model improvement gates are reported separately.
verification_strategy: Full 72-test runtime suite, then 3 isolated acceptance-boundary tests after a one-line evaluation threshold fix. Runtime behavior was unchanged by the latter patch; combined discovery is 75. The full 75-test suite was not redundantly rerun.
linux_isolation: Offline Debian 13 x86_64 guest, no NIC, dedicated disk overlay; all owned VMs shut down normally with exit 0.
package_and_extracted_cli: Passed on Windows and both Linux versions for the 72-test runtime snapshot; final documentation/report packaging is checked separately.

probe_harness.temporary_exclusive_lock: Passed: read recovery preserves native exit 7 and exactly one operation event.
probe_harness.persistent_exclusive_lock: Passed: three bounded read retries, four retained errors, exit 2/unknown; operation not repeated.
probe_harness.finding: A reproduced response-open PermissionError overlapped atomic replacement after the writer had closed its stream. The deeper Windows filter/sandbox cause and the original two anomalies cannot be proven from retained evidence.

release_note: These checks alone do not establish the real-agent recall, repeated-error or tool-call improvement targets. Claude testing was removed from required acceptance by the user. Hosted GitHub CI has not run before push.
